system.description:
Soothing rhythms emanate from the sorcerer and make agreeable his desires. This incantation grants bonus dice to Seduction, Haggling, Oratory, Persuasion and Circles tests. Meeting the obstacle adds +1D to the listed abilities. Up to two more successes can be spent to add two more dice to a maximum bonus of +3D.

Obstacle: 4^. Actions: 10.

Origin: Personal | Area of Effect: Caster | Element: Anima | Impetus: Enhance | Duration: Sustained | Resource Points: 16

^ When pricing this spell in resource points, it costs 4 rps per point of obstacle rather than 2.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 207
